title: File
description: The fourth backbone node and the settled result of TRC's descent path -> object -> attribute -> file (mirroring voidmath's cell -> fiber -> presheaf -> sheaf). The file is not the carrier (the path is); it is what the descent settles to, with the filesystem-type taxonomy (restricting/library/{directory, regular-file, ...}) hanging off it as the sheaf-end, each subkind reached by its restriction morphism. Per the README the file node corresponds to voidmath's sheaf at the finite/settle regime. Minimal type-witness for the node; its full structural content is the voidmath sheaf it carries, whose on-disk derivation is a separate task.
